findings.description: none: WAIT remediation verified against roadmap-orchestration Wait policy selected under budget constraints. With `policy.default_action == WAIT`, `select_registry_lane` and `_handle_vendor_limit` return wait without registry alternate selection; `_persist_policy_pause` writes schema-compatible `pause_state` (`paused`, `reason`, `blocked_vendor`, `expected_resume_at` when known via `capacity_reset_at` or safe `capacity_retry_after_seconds`); active pauses refuse redispatch until reset then clear and resume the same checkpoint phase; SWITCH still retries the exact selected lane with bounded `max_switch_attempts_per_item`.
